scope: Mechanics and visuals are approved as the desired base; per-card rules, values, and production mapping remain to be authored. This is an inventory, not runtime content.

authoringDefaults.manaFloor: Every spell and weapon art costs at least 1 base MP; apply the same policy to authored variants unless an explicit approved exception says otherwise.
authoringDefaults.weaponArts: Set weapon-art damage by explicit comparison with the current Smash baseline before costs; do not infer damage/cost from proposal text alone.
authoringDefaults.unspecifiedParameters: Resolve to the smallest concrete value that preserves the stated effect; match core card effects, costs, durations, targets and lifecycle; record selected values in final rules.
authoringDefaults.statusCompatibility: An existing status name or opcode only supplies a primitive. Match decay, trigger, target, magnitude, removal and turn timing before marking a proposal reusable.
